White background maker for product photos

Choose product photos taken on a plain background. The tool makes the background pure white and centers the product.

How it works

  1. Choose your product photos, ideally on a plain or light background.
  2. Pick a canvas size. Raise the sensitivity if background is left, lower it if the product is being cut.
  3. Click the button, check the result, and download it.

Good to know

  • It works best on plain backgrounds. Busy backgrounds are not removed.
  • A white product on a white background cannot be separated. Use a darker backdrop when you take the photo.
  • Marketplace rules change, so check your marketplace's current image rules before you upload.

Common questions

How do I make a product photo background white?

Photograph the product on a plain background, upload it here, and the tool turns that background pure white and centers the product.

Does it remove complicated backgrounds?

No. This version removes plain, even backgrounds. Photos with patterns, people or busy scenes need a different tool.
